posts.title: ✍️ CRM in local government
posts.description: I’ve been doing some digging into CRM for a couple of clients recently, and thought I’d share my crib sheet here. Hopefully useful! Summary Before doing anything relating to CRM, some fundamental questions must be answered: What is ‘CRM’? This feels like a silly question to ask, but actually, many people have differing views on […]
